entities.summary: Bruno Beger was a German racial anthropologist, ethnologist, and explorer who worked for the Ahnenerbe. In that role he participated in Ernst Schäfer's 1938–1939 expedition to Tibet, helped the SS Race and Settlement Main Office identify Jews, and later helped select human subjects to be killed to create an anatomical study collection of Jewish skulls.
